title: Playing at Shakey's Inn
summary: Pam asks about the photos; they discuss an August 1972 clipping and Riddick's ten years at Shakey's Inn.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: I'd have to look for it, but I'd have to go through it again. Oh, look. Pam can ask you questions, if you've got any questions, Pam. What do you want to know, Pam, honey?
Well, it's just good listening and having you tell me about all these photographs. And there are a lot of people here that I don't know.
Now, this is Chicago, I think, Capital News. So many, many years have gone by. So many, many, many. Tex River. Octatum.
This is dated August 1972. Were you at Shaky's Inn? Yeah.
Ten years. I know you were there in 66 because Pushera told me about it. Then, you know, I just... Yeah. Happened to have that on tape. This is Capital Records.
